title: IAL
line: A Success Stories page with search and filters.
problem: The Institute for Adult Learning (IAL), an autonomous institute under SUSS, focuses on professionalising adult education through training, research, innovation and lifelong learning. Visitors to its website needed an easier way to browse IAL's success stories.
did: As a Full-stack Developer, I built a Success Stories page with search and filters. Using C# and Kentico CMS, I retrieved and structured the page data, implemented category and year filters and optimised the Razor views to keep the card layouts consistent.
outcome: Visitors can now find the success stories that matter to them in just a few clicks.

cover.alt: The Institute for Adult Learning homepage, with a banner for the WSQ Advanced Certificate in Learning and Performance

story.title: Situation
story.body: The Institute for Adult Learning (IAL), an autonomous institute under SUSS, focuses on professionalising adult education through training, research, innovation and lifelong learning. Visitors to its website needed an easier way to browse IAL's success stories.

story.title: Task
story.body: Working with the project manager, my task was to build a Success Stories page where visitors could search and filter the stories.

story.title: Action
story.body: Using C# and Kentico CMS, I retrieved the page data and structured it for the new page. I then implemented category and year filters alongside the search, and optimised the Razor views so that every story card keeps a consistent layout.

story.title: Result
story.body: Visitors can now find the success stories that matter to them in just a few clicks.

notes: Written with STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result). Add a screenshot of the Success Stories page if IAL allows.
